scripts.release: wxt build && mkdir -p release && V=$(node -p "require('./dist/chrome-mv3/manifest.json').version") && rm -f "release/calyxa-$V.zip" && (cd dist/chrome-mv3 && zip -qr "../../release/calyxa-$V.zip" .) && echo "→ packaged release/calyxa-$V.zip" && ls -1t release/calyxa-*.zip | tail -n +6 | while read -r f; do rm -- "$f" && echo "pruned old build $f"; done
